mutant.description: Two negative arms. (1) The inheritance arm: the parent session's own PIP_NO_INDEX reads empty while the User-scope registry value reads 1, so a child that printed 1 got it from the registry and not from this session. (2) The failure-mode arm: the first fresh-child pip run (attempt B) ended rc=2 with the folder empty, the exact signs the order's BLOCKED test reads, yet the cause was an ssl initialisation crash with SystemRoot absent, not PIP_NO_INDEX. The valid arm was therefore graded on pip's 'from versions: none' signature as well as rc and folder, and a crash is graded INCONCLUSIVE.
mutant.expected: Parent value empty and child value 1; the crash arm must NOT be graded BLOCKED; the valid arm must print the 'from versions: none' signature with ssl_error=0.
mutant.observed: FIRED AS EXPECTED. Parent process PIP_NO_INDEX=[] and User scope [1]; child FRESH-PROCESS PIP_NO_INDEX=1. Attempt B: ssl.SSLError 0xa080024, rc=2, folder 0, withdrawn. Attempt C: rc=1, 'from versions: none', folder 0, discriminators signature_from_versions_none=1 ssl_error=0.

determinism.method: N/A: one read of one variable and one download attempt through one form. The two fresh-child runs differ in a stated input (SystemRoot set inside the child) and so are not repeats.

declared_exclusions.reason: It does not run on this box in that mode: 'Loading managed Windows PowerShell failed with error 8009001d', exit -65536, before any statement. The order's 'nearest equivalent' was used: cmd.exe with the same -UseNewEnvironment flag. Row NFRA_CTLPLN-D1-S11.

NOT OBSERVED. The mechanism's environment lacks SystemRoot and USERPROFILE and reports USERNAME=SYSTEM, with an empty Machine Path (System32 absent). The variable PIP_NO_INDEX does reach it (AC1). For the download arm the child was repaired by setting SystemRoot=C:\WINDOWS INSIDE the child (nothing on the machine changed), because without it pip crashes before it reads any index setting. The verdict is for that repaired child, the nearest stand-in available; whether a real logon shell is required is the issuer's and the CTO's call (row D1-S11).

pip's download verb ran twice: attempt B crashed in ssl initialisation (no request, nothing written) and attempt C is the valid arm. Both folders were deleted with absence controls. Attempt A (powershell child) never reached pip.
